messages:
maria: Heads up — invoice-preview is showing ~3.2% higher token counts for tenants hitting route=multi-llama after last night's routing-policy rollout. Spotted in billing smoke tests.
ken: saw this too. console per-route token meter matches logs, but invoice-preview (agg job) is higher. My hunch: duplicates from streaming path + finalize path both being counted.
jess: +1 on that theory. streaming emits partial token events, finalize emits final token event. Our dedupe currently keys on fingerprint + invoice_window + route_tag. If routing tag changed between partial and final we fail to dedupe.
sam: I traced a couple: partial event has route=multi-llama, finalize got route=fallback-llama (policy fallback). Example headers we saw:
```
{ "fingerprint":"abc123", "route":"multi-llama", "dedupe_key":"abc123|w=2026-02-18T10|v1" }
```
finalize:
```
{ "fingerprint":"abc123", "route":"fallback-llama", "dedupe_key":"abc123|w=2026-02-18T10|v1" }
```
Deduper considers route part of key in v1 -> mismatch.
maria: So root cause is dedupe key invbaking route. Changing keys is risky for older consumers though.
jess: We can do additive schema change: add canonical_fingerprint (string) and dedupe_version. Aggregator will prefer canonical_fingerprint if present; otherwise fallback to old behavior. That way rollout is opt-in and backwards compatible.
lee: Will aggregator switch cause invoice-preview churn during rollout? We need a safe canary plan.
ken: Proposed rollout: deploy aggregator change to canary cluster (10% tenants). Enable use_canonical=true for canary only. Keep original dedupe running as shadow (no switching) for 24h and compare deltas. If delta <0.1% and no regressions, flip gradually. Also add console UX to show dedupe_key_version per route (small flag in invoice preview) so finance can eyeball.
sam: Also add ingest-side header opt-in in clientlib: X-Redwood-CanonFP:true so SDKs can emit canonical_fingerprint ASAP. Backfill will still be needed for historical events.
ingest-bot: alert: 0.8% of metering events in last 24h missing canonical_fingerprint field (schema:v2 not rolled everywhere).
jess: For detection and verification we used this SQL to find duplicates by fingerprint:
```
SELECT fingerprint, count(*) as cnt
FROM metering_events
WHERE invoice_window = '2026-02-18'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Most duplicates have differing route tags in the per-event metadata.
maria: Good catch. Action items: jess -> aggregator PR (add canonical_fingerprint + dedupe_version + feature flag), sam -> backfill script and duplicate-scan queries, ken -> canary rollout + console flag, lee -> update alerts and put temporary hold on provisional invoice emails for affected tenants.
ken: timeline: PRs today, canary deploy tomorrow 06:00 UTC, 6h observation window, subsequent ramp if stable. If backfill needed, prepare credit-adjust flow with finance.
olivia: FYI finance: will pause invoice previews for tenants in canary cohort and prepare contingency credits. tagging @finance-runbook.
maria: Sounds good. Quick mitigation if spike persists: add a short-term dedupe-by-time heuristic in aggregator that suppresses events with identical fingerprint within 60s regardless of route (cheap stopgap).
sam: can implement as config toggle. prefer not to rely on it long-term but helpful for emergency.
jess: I'll open PR for canonical_fingerprint + aggregator flag and include unit tests for mixed route tags. Will document schema addendum.
maria: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll create the tracker ticket and link this thread + SQL results. Keep chat updates here for rollouts or any blockers.
ken: one more — add telemetry to console: show "dup_candidate_rate" (fraction of fingerprints with >1 event) in per-route dashboard to monitor after flip.
olivia: noted, will coordinate with billing ops if backfill triggers mass credits.
maria: closing for now, please update ticket when PRs land and paste canary metrics here.
